agyos_skill.instructions: Systematic production framework for engineering high-retention YouTube long-form videos (8 to 25 minutes). Covers market validation, packaging pre-production, retention scriptwriting, B-roll generation with Google Flow, and automated audio/video post-production. 1. **Packaging Before Scripting**: Never write a script without at least 3 verified title/thumbnail pairs. If an idea cannot be packaged into a compelling click proposition, it will not earn views regardless of production quality. 2. **Immediate Proof of Concept (First 30 Seconds)**: Pay off the thumbnail and title within the first 30 seconds. Never open with a greeting ("Hey guys"), channel logo sting, or housekeeping announcements. 3. **Pacing Resets Every 5-7 Seconds**: Change visual information (B-roll cutaway, camera punch-in, graphic callout, screen recording, lower third) every 5 to 7 seconds to maintain active attention. 4. **Session Extension Dominance**: Structure the video ending as a psychological bridge to another video in the channel catalog rather than a slow concluding wind-down. - **Angle 1 (Curiosity Gap)**: Focus on an unexpected counterintuitive result (*"Why Silicon Valley Stopped Writing Code"*). - **Angle 2 (High Stakes)**: Focus on personal consequence or risk (*"The Database Mistake That Cost Us $84,000"*). - **Angle 3 (Systemic Deep-Dive)**: Authoritative, definitive framework (*"How Modern High-Frequency Trading Actually Works"*). - **Rule of Visual Contrast**: Foreground subject must maintain at least 4.5:1 luminance contrast against background. - **Maximum 3-Word Text**: Thumbnail text must complement, not repeat, the title words. - **Expression & Gaze**: If using human face, direct eye contact or gaze aimed toward the core visual element. ``` 0:00 ─── Act 1: The Hook & The Unresolved Loop (0:00 - 0:45) Pay off packaging immediately. Introduce the central conflict. 0:45 ─── Act 2: Context & Early Payoff (0:45 - 3:30) Establish foundational knowledge. Deliver one rapid insight to reward the viewer. 3:30 ─── Act 3: Escalation & Depth (3:30 - 14:00) Segmented into 3-minute sub-chapters. Open a new curiosity loop before closing the old one. 14:00 ── Act 4: The Climax & Session Bridge (14:00 - End) Deliver final resolution. Cut immediately to next suggested video (zero outro filler). ``` Every long-form script must contain concrete production cues: ```text [VISUAL]: Primary camera / talking head (Medium close-up, 50mm). [AUDIO]: Voiceover narration with steady, conversational pacing (155 WPM).
